title: NATS request/reply studio.plugins.pass (pipelines → studio)
description: From API 1.70 (contracts/README.md, Plugins: takes). Core NATS request/reply on subject `studio.plugins.pass` (queue group `studio`), bare JSON: pipelines asks for the pass of one plugin tool call before it calls the plugin (`Authorization: Bearer <pass>`). Studio signs it (HMAC-SHA256 with a key only studio holds) for the owner, the plugin and the call, valid 300 s, and verifies it itself on /v1/studio/plugin/*: a pass opens the caller's takes only while the plugin is on and its manifest says `takes`. `api` is studio's public base URL (the plugin's `X-Helm-Api`). A plugin that is off or not an assistant-tools plugin is not_found; one whose manifest lacks `takes` gets no pass (`api` alone): pipelines sends it no Authorization and drops any take_ids it answers. After a call whose reply names take_ids, pipelines asks again with them (`take_ids`) and studio answers `made`: only those of the owner with source tool that this plugin made under this call id (takes.tool's plugin and call), so a line's Undo never deletes a take the call did not make. Never stored, never on a stream. Studio answers within 5 s.

take_ids.description: the ids the call's reply named: studio answers `made` instead of a pass
those of the request's take_ids this plugin made under this call id (may be empty)

pass.description: base64url(JSON {owner, plugin, call, exp}) . base64url(HMAC-SHA256); absent for a plugin whose manifest lacks takes
